body.heading: Why some notes get kept
paragraphs: Ask people about the notes in their drawer and a pattern appears: the kept ones are specific, they mention the effect, and they arrived when nothing was expected. Generic thanks are appreciated for a day; specific thanks get reread for years.
Writing one takes about four minutes. The maths on that is extraordinary — four minutes of effort, years of someone feeling seen.

body.heading: The kept-note formula
paragraphs: Name the thing: not 'thanks for everything' but 'thanks for driving forty minutes in the rain.' Name the effect: 'It meant I didn't have to face that day alone.' And add one true line about them: 'You are the person who shows up.'
Handwritten beats typed, and typed beats never sent. Do not let the perfect envelope be the enemy of the sent note.
